o: The frequency at which a creature stops noticing the flicker of light
questions.e: In the video: "kritičnu frekvenciju fuzije treptanja... koliko brzo svetlo mora da treperi kako bi neko živo biće prestalo da primećuje treptanje." — the critical flicker fusion frequency... how fast a light must flicker for a living being to stop noticing the flicker.
In the video: "ono što diktira koliki će nam biti CFF je brzina našeg metabolizma" — what dictates how big our CFF will be is the speed of our metabolism.

questions.q: Why can't a dog see a video on a 60 Hz phone?
o: It sees only black and white
It doesn't look at the screen
questions.e: In the video: "psi vide sa CFF-om većim od 80 Hz" — dogs see with a CFF greater than 80 Hz.
In the video: "psi mogu videti manji spektar boja, odnosno samo plavu i žutu boju" — dogs can see a smaller spectrum of colors, namely only blue and yellow.

questions.q: How do cats differ from humans in CFF?
o: Theirs is higher than a dog's
Theirs is lower — 50 Hz, and they see us slightly sped up
questions.e: In the video: "mačke imaju manji CFF čak i od nas... 50 Hz. Znači, mačke nas vide malo ubrzano" — cats have a lower CFF even than us... 50 Hz. So cats see us slightly sped up.

questions.q: Whom does the author call the winner in vision?
questions.e: In the video: "Imaju i dobar periferni vid, što ih čini definitivnim pobednikom što se tiče vida" — they also have good peripheral vision, which makes them the definitive winner when it comes to vision.

questions.q: What does CFF depend on in reptiles?
questions.e: In the video: "sa promenom temperature menja i brzina njihovog metabolizma. Samim tim i CFF." — with a change in temperature, the speed of their metabolism changes. And therefore the CFF too.

questions.q: Which animal lives a very long time and has a CFF of only 10 Hz?
questions.e: In the video: "kopnena kornjača... CFF od samo 10 Hz" — the land tortoise... a CFF of only 10 Hz.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.e: Treptanje — blinking, flickering; treptati — to blink.
Njuh — the sense of smell.
Oštar — sharp, crisp; oštrije — sharper, crisper.
Glodar — a rodent; glodati — to gnaw.
Ubrzati — to speed up; ubrzano — sped up.

questions.q: Hrčci i *veverice* idu na oko 80 Hz.
questions.e: Veverica — a squirrel.
Cvet — a flower.

questions.q: Životinja koja živi veoma dugo je kopnena *kornjača*.
questions.e: Kornjača — a turtle, a tortoise.

questions.q: Mačke imaju manji CFF čak i od ___.
questions.e: Od ("than") requires the genitive case: od nas.
Vrste of what? Genitive plural: fotoreceptora.
Direct object, inanimate: the accusative coincides with the nominative — spektar.

questions.q: Skoro sve ___ imaju čak 4 vrste fotoreceptora.
questions.e: The subject is in the nominative plural: ptice.

questions.q: Zato u najmračnijim ___ vide izvanredno dobro.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative plural: prostorijama.
The adjective agrees with vodama in the locative plural: dubokim.
Kod ("in") requires the genitive case: kod insekata.

questions.q: Oni vide plavu, zelenu i ___ boju.
questions.e: The adjective is in the accusative case, feminine, like boju: ultraljubičastu.
